subject: Intro: Dedicated capacity intake — Staging Labs throughput check
body:
From: Jill Parker <jill@staginglabs.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry: Dedicated capacity for high-throughput inference

Hi Ben / Mina,

We just completed a self-serve signup and indicated interest in a Dedicated deployment for low-latency inference. I'm the engineering lead on this effort at Staging Labs — we run inference for our real-time feature scoring and need predictable tail latency at 99th percentile.

High level:
- Peak concurrent requests: ~250 QPS (burst to 400 for 2–3 mins)
- Typical request size: 512 tokens input, 64 tokens output
- Target 99th pct latency: < 250ms
- Data residency: US-East (we can provide SOC2 evidence)

Can someone on your team share next steps for a technical intake and availability for a walkthrough? I've attached a quick capacity summary.

Thanks,
Jill Parker
Engineering Lead, Staging Labs
--- attachment: staging_capacity_profile.csv (text/csv, 54KB)

---

--- Original message header end ---

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jill Parker <jill@staginglabs.io>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:33:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: Dedicated capacity for high-throughput inference

Hi Jill — thanks for signing up and for the details. I'm Ben (SDR) at Redwood, looping Mina (solutions engineering) to coordinate a short technical intake so we can scope Dedicated capacity and confirm latency SLOs.

Immediate options:
- 30m technical intake (pre-call): Thu 10/8 10:00–10:30 PT or Fri 10/9 11:00–11:30 PT
- 45m walkthrough w/ SA: Mon 10/12 14:00–14:45 PT

Can you confirm which slot works? Also, would you be able to share any representative request/response sizes (JSON schema ok) or the trace of tail latency?

Calendly (if easier): https://calendly.com/redwood-sdr/30min?month=2026-10

Best,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0113

---

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Jill Parker <jill@staginglabs.io>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 10:02:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: Dedicated capacity for high-throughput inference

Hi Jill — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the capacity snapshot. I work on Dedicated sizing and will run through a short intake ahead of the walkthrough so we can tailor the demo to your latency/throughput profile.

Requesting two small things before the call:
1) Can you attach a tiny sample of a request/response payload (anonymized) so we can estimate tokenization?
2) Do you have a hard requirement on P99 vs P95? P99 targets under 250ms are achievable but depend on batching and model choice.

I'm available on Thu 10/8 10:00–10:30 PT — I can join the pre-call and then hand to Marcus (our Solutions Architect) for the full walkthrough. I'll also attach our intake checklist.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0167
--- attachment: redwood-dedicated-intake.pdf (application/pdf, 128KB)

---

From: Jill Parker <jill@staginglabs.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 08:47:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: Dedicated capacity for high-throughput inference

Thanks both. Thu 10/8 10:00 PT works for us.

I've attached an anonymized sample payload and a one-page notes doc (see attachment). Quick answers inline:
- Sample payload: attached as sample_request.json (embedded in the CSV bundle)
- Latency target: P99 < 250ms is critical for us; P95 < 120ms is a nice-to-have
- We expect bursts aligned with business events (up to 400 QPS) and would like an autoscale plan that avoids cold-starts for short bursts if possible.

I'll add Marcus (our infra PM) to the invite if you want to bring an SA.

Best,
Jill
--- attachment: staging_payload_bundle.zip (application/zip, 72KB)

---

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Jill Parker <jill@staginglabs.io>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: Dedicated capacity for high-throughput inference

Hi Jill — adding Marcus from Redwood's SA team to align on autoscale and capacity buffer strategies. Marcus — quick context: Staging Labs is looking for Dedicated capacity to serve ~250 QPS with short bursts to 400 and a P99 latency target < 250ms. They've shared an anonymized payload and a CSV with sample traces.

Proposed plan for Thu 10/8 10:00 PT (30m):
- 10m: Quick architecture & traffic profile (Jill)
- 10m: Sizing sketch + kernel/quantization options (Marcus)
- 10m: Next steps / mutual action plan (Mina)

Pre-call ask: please upload any spike/event cadence notes to the HubSpot record (link below) or paste them in the meeting chat.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
---

> Thanks Mina — I can cover batching strategy and autoscale buffers. I'll bring a quick latency-vs-cost slide so Staging can see tradeoffs between serving variants.
> 
> See you Thu.
> 
> Marcus Lin

Perfect — confirms for Thu 10/8 10:00 PT. Marcus, thanks for joining. I've added the event to our calendar and invited the attendees.

A quick note: we'll have our SRE (Sam) on the call to discuss network egress and VPC peering — Sam will join from 10:00–10:20 PT.

See you then.

Best,
Jill Parker
Engineering Lead, Staging Labs
